main_text.l: Quam radiolis a Sole per nubeculas-
Hinc Solis umbram vivido sine lumine-
Tantum gerit, nec frena vel virgam
tenetImbellis, animos nec coercens, nec regens.
Hac vero quanto dignior nubes procul-
SOLIDA, rudes quae sola mentes perpolit-
Ad hanc, procul post se relictis omnibus,
Solus licet, nec obrutus libris, gradu-
Nec fallet illum spes: profanos nam quidem-
A monte murus arcet; at fideliter-
Qui sic refecti fructibus montis sacri-

page.notes: The verse is printed in italic with some words in small capitals (ERUDITIO, SOLIDA). The word "Viro" at lower right is set in italic and may be a catchword or signature; it is transcribed as printed. Some letters are faint or broken by specks, notably "Pertinne" and "Pulsantibus", which may be misprints or damage; the reading "Pertinne" is doubtful. Long s has been rendered as s throughout.
